scanNote:
14-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (101-bet) - KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR.

Yuqorida o'ngda TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '14', chapida 'Live and Let Live'.

CHAP USTUN:
12) a) 'Study the rule and the example.' KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Reporting General Truths': 'When we report something which IS ALWAYS TRUE the verb tense is the SAME as in direct speech.' Direct Speech: 'Green-cheeked parrots LIVE in Mexico.' Reported Speech: 'He said that green-cheeked parrots LIVE in Mexico.'
   b) 'Rewrite the sentences in reported speech and explain how they are formed.' 1 "Racoons are grey with a striped tail," she said. 2 "Grey squirrels have got long, bushy tails," he said. 3 "Hedgehogs sleep during the winter," she said. 4 "Male deer grow antlers every year," he told us.
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Reported Questions'.
13) 'Study the examples and the rules. How do reported wh-questions differ from reported Yes/No questions?' (ayol surati) Direct Speech: 'Where do you live?' 'Have you got a pet?' Reported Speech: 'She asked (me) WHERE I LIVED.' 'She asked (me) IF I HAD A PET.'
   KO'K-YaShIL QUTI 'Reported Questions': 'WH-QUESTIONS: In reported speech the word order is: ask/etc + wh- + subject + verb. YES/NO QUESTIONS: In reported speech the word order is: ask/etc + if + subject + verb.'
14) Qiya: 'Greg is interested in buying a dog. Last Friday he saw a dog in a pet shop, and he asked the shop owner some questions.' 'Report his questions.' (o'g'il bola surati, pufaklar): 1 How old is it? 2 What kind of dog is it? 3 Does it need a lot of exercise? 4 What does it eat? 5 How often does it need to go to the vet? 6 How much does it cost?

O'NG USTUN:
15) 'Rewrite the sentences in reported speech.' 1 "I'm thinking of adopting a dolphin," Steve said. 2 "How often do you go there?" Sheila asked Jim. 3 "Can I join the club?" Claire asked Jeff. 4 "It was his birthday on 6th May," Mary said. 5 "I've fed the chickens," Tommy said.
• To'q sariq 'Communication: Arranging to Meet Somebody'.
16) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and fill in the missing words, then use the prompts to act out similar dialogues.' A: Do you want to come to the 1) ...... on Saturday? It'll be fun. B: OK. What time? A: Well, not later than 2) ...... . B: Fine. I'll meet you at the 3) ...... at TEN O'CLOCK, then. A: Promise you'll be on 4) ......? B: Yes, I promise! Nuqtalar: • aquarium - six thirty - entrance - six • Natural History Museum - twelve - information desk - eleven thirty • circus - seven - bus stop - six thirty.
• To'q sariq 'Writing (Project)': 'Use the notes in the Photo File section to write two short articles about the jaguar and the African elephant.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '101'.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the rule and the example. When we report something which is always true the verb tense is the same as in direct speech. "Green-cheeked parrots live in Mexico." → He said that green-cheeked parrots live in Mexico.
exercises.instructionUz: Qoida va misolni o'rganing. Har doim to'g'ri bo'lgan narsani ko'chirganimizda fe'l zamoni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapdagi bilan bir xil bo'ladi. "Yashil yuzli to'tiqushlar Meksikada yashaydi." → U yashil yuzli to'tiqushlar Meksikada yashashini aytdi.
exercises.explanationUz:
UMUMIY HAQIQATLAR - ZAMON
O'ZGARMAYDI!

  'Parrots LIVE in Mexico' - bu har
  doim to'g'ri (fakt).
  → 'He said that parrots LIVE in
    Mexico.' - 'lived' EMAS!

  ⚠ Faktlar, tabiat qonunlari,
  odatlar - hozirgi zamonda qoladi.


⚠ 'A GENERAL TRUTH':

  = umumiy haqiqat, fakt.


⚠ 'ALWAYS TRUE':

  = har doim to'g'ri.

points.en: When we report something which is always true the verb tense is the same as in direct speech.
points.uz: Har doim to'g'ri bo'lgan narsani ko'chirganimizda fe'l zamoni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gapdagi bilan bir xil bo'ladi.

points.en: "Green-cheeked parrots live in Mexico." → He said that green-cheeked parrots live in Mexico.
points.uz: "Yashil yuzli to'tiqushlar Meksikada yashaydi." → U yashil yuzli to'tiqushlar Meksikada yashashini aytdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in reported speech and explain how they are formed.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni ko'chirma gapda qayta yozing va ular qanday tuzilganini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR (zamon O'ZGARMAYDI -
umumiy haqiqatlar):

  1 She said (that) racoons ARE
    grey with a striped tail.
  2 He said (that) grey squirrels
    HAVE GOT long, bushy tails.
  3 She said (that) hedgehogs SLEEP
    during the winter.
  4 He told us (that) male deer
    GROW antlers every year.

  ⚠ Hammasi hayvonlar haqidagi
  faktlar → present simple qoladi.


⚠ 'A RACOON':

  = yenot.


⚠ 'A SQUIRREL':

  = olmaxon. /ˈskwɪrəl/.


⚠ 'BUSHY':

  = quyuq, patli (dum).


⚠ 'A HEDGEHOG':

  = tipratikan.


⚠ 'DEER':

  = bug'u. Birlik = ko'plik!


⚠ 'ANTLERS':

  = shoxlar (bug'u).

items.textEn: 1 "Racoons are grey with a striped tail," she said. → She said (that) racoons ___ grey with a striped tail.
2 "Grey squirrels have got long, bushy tails," he said. → He said (that) grey squirrels ___ long, bushy tails.
3 "Hedgehogs sleep during the winter," she said. → She said (that) hedgehogs ___ during the winter.
4 "Male deer grow antlers every year," he told us. → He told us (that) male deer ___ antlers every year.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples and the rules. How do reported wh-questions differ from reported Yes/No questions? "Where do you live?" → She asked (me) where I lived. "Have you got a pet?" → She asked (me) if I had a pet.
exercises.instructionUz: Misollar va qoidalarni o'rganing. Ko'chirma wh-savollar ko'chirma Ha/Yo'q savollaridan qanday farq qiladi? "Qayerda yashaysiz?" → U (mendan) qayerda yashashimni so'radi. "Uy hayvoningiz bormi?" → U (mendan) uy hayvonim bor-yo'qligini so'radi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOLLAR.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WH-SAVOLLAR                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask + WH- + EGA + FE'L
  'Where do you live?' →
  'She asked WHERE I LIVED.'

  ⚠ So'roq so'zi (where, what, how)
  SAQLANADI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  HA/YO'Q SAVOLLAR                ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  ask + IF + EGA + FE'L
  'Have you got a pet?' →
  'She asked IF I HAD a pet.'

  ⚠ So'roq so'zi yo'q → 'IF'
  (yoki 'whether') qo'shiladi.


⚠ UMUMIY QOIDALAR:

  1 SO'Z TARTIBI - darak gapdek:
    EGA + FE'L ('where I lived' -
    'where did I live' EMAS!)
  2 'do/does/did' YO'QOLADI.
  3 SO'ROQ BELGISI YO'Q.
  4 ZAMON bir qadam orqaga:
    live → lived; have got → had.
  5 OLMOSh o'zgaradi: you → I.


⚠ 'TO DIFFER FROM':

  = ...dan farq qilmoq.

points.en: Wh-questions: In reported speech the word order is: ask/etc + wh- + subject + verb. "Where do you live?" → She asked (me) where I lived.
points.uz: Wh-savollar: ko'chirma gapda so'z tartibi: ask + wh- + ega + fe'l. "Qayerda yashaysiz?" → U qayerda yashashimni so'radi.

points.en: Yes/No questions: In reported speech the word order is: ask/etc + if + subject + verb. "Have you got a pet?" → She asked (me) if I had a pet.
points.uz: Ha/Yo'q savollar: ko'chirma gapda so'z tartibi: ask + if + ega + fe'l. "Uy hayvoningiz bormi?" → U uy hayvonim bor-yo'qligini so'radi.

points.en: Difference: wh-questions keep the question word; Yes/No questions add 'if'. Both use statement word order and no question mark.
points.uz: Farqi: wh-savollar so'roq so'zini saqlaydi; Ha/Yo'q savollarga 'if' qo'shiladi. Ikkalasi ham darak gap tartibida va so'roq belgisisiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Greg is interested in buying a dog. Last Friday he saw a dog in a pet shop, and he asked the shop owner some questions. Report his questions. 1 How old is it? 2 What kind of dog is it? 3 Does it need a lot of exercise? 4 What does it eat? 5 How often does it need to go to the vet? 6 How much does it cost?
exercises.instructionUz: Greg it sotib olishga qiziqadi. O'tgan juma u uy hayvonlari do'konida itni ko'rdi va do'kon egasiga bir nechta savol berdi. Uning savollarini ko'chiring. 1 U necha yoshda? 2 U qanday it? 3 Unga ko'p mashq kerakmi? 4 U nima yeydi? 5 U qanchalik tez-tez veterinarga borishi kerak? 6 U qancha turadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 Greg asked (the shop owner) how
    old it WAS.
  2 He asked what kind of dog it
    WAS.
  3 He asked IF it NEEDED a lot of
    exercise.
  4 He asked what it ATE.
  5 He asked how often it NEEDED
    to go to the vet.
  6 He asked how much it COST.

  ⚠ 3 - Ha/Yo'q savol → 'if'.
  ⚠ Qolganlari wh-savollar.
  ⚠ 'does' yo'qoladi, fe'l past
  simple: need → needed, eat →
  ate, cost → cost.


⚠ 'A VET':

  = veterinar ('veterinary
  surgeon' ning qisqasi).


⚠ 'A PET SHOP':

  = uy hayvonlari do'koni.


⚠ 'THE SHOP OWNER':

  = do'kon egasi.

items.textEn: 1 "How old is it?" → Greg asked the shop owner ___.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'how old IT WAS' - is → was, tartib darak gapdek.

items.textEn: 2 "What kind of dog is it?" → He asked ___.
items.answer: what kind of dog it was

items.textEn: 3 "Does it need a lot of exercise?" → He asked ___.
items.answer: if it needed a lot of exercise

items.textEn: 5 "How often does it need to go to the vet?" → He asked ___.
items.answer: how often it needed to go to the vet

items.textEn: 6 "How much does it cost?" → He asked ___.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'how much it COST' - cost o'zgarmaydigan fe'l.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the sentences in reported speech.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 Steve said (that) he WAS
    THINKING of adopting a dolphin.
  2 Sheila asked Jim how often he
    WENT there.
  3 Claire asked Jeff IF she COULD
    join the club.
  4 Mary said (that) it HAD BEEN
    his birthday on 6th May.
  5 Tommy said (that) he HAD FED
    the chickens.

  ⚠ 3 - 'Can I' → 'if she could'.
  ⚠ 4 - 'was' → 'had been' (past
  simple → past perfect).
  ⚠ 5 - 'I've fed' → 'he had fed'.


⚠ 'TO FEED':

  fed - fed. = boqmoq.


⚠ 'TO THINK OF + -ING':

  = ... haqida o'ylamoq.

items.textEn: 1 "I'm thinking of adopting a dolphin," Steve said. → Steve said (that) ___.
items.answer: he was thinking of adopting a dolphin

items.textEn: 2 "How often do you go there?" Sheila asked Jim. → Sheila asked Jim ___.
3 "Can I join the club?" Claire asked Jeff. → Claire asked Jeff ___.
items.answer: if she could join the club

items.textEn: 4 "It was his birthday on 6th May," Mary said. → Mary said (that) ___.
items.answer: it had been his birthday on 6th May

items.textEn: 5 "I've fed the chickens," Tommy said. → Tommy said (that) ___.

exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va tushirib qoldirilgan so'zlarni to'ldiring, keyin ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglarni o'ynang. • aquarium - six thirty - entrance - six • Natural History Museum - twelve - information desk - eleven thirty • circus - seven - bus stop - six thirty
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ AUDIO KERAK - 1-3 bo'shliqlar
faqat yozuvdan. 4 - 'on TIME'
(aniq).


QOLIP (ko'rsatmalar tartibi):
  1) JOY (aquarium / museum /
     circus)
  2) VAQT - kechikmaslik (six thirty
     / twelve / seven)
  3) UChRAShUV JOYI (entrance /
     information desk / bus stop)
  UChRAShUV VAQTI (six / eleven
     thirty / six thirty)
  4) 'on TIME' = o'z vaqtida


UChRAShUV BELGILASh IBORALARI:

  Do you want to come to ...? =
    ...ga bormoqchimisan?
  What time? = Soat nechada?
  Not later than ... = ...dan kech
    emas.
  I'll meet you at ... = Seni ...da
    kutaman.
  Promise you'll be on time? =
    O'z vaqtida kelishga va'da
    berasanmi?


⚠ 'AN AQUARIUM':

  = akvarium (katta, jamoat).


⚠ 'AN ENTRANCE':

  = kirish (eshik).


⚠ 'A CIRCUS':

  = sirk.


⚠ 'ON TIME':

  = o'z vaqtida.
  ⚠ 'in time' = ulgurib.

items.answer: Well, not later than six thirty. - Fine. I'll meet you at the entrance at six, then. - Promise you'll be on time? - Yes, I promise!

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes in the Photo File section to write two short articles about the jaguar and the African elephant.
exercises.instructionUz: Photo File bo'limidagi qaydlardan foydalanib yaguar va Afrika fili haqida ikkita qisqa maqola yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Qaydlar kitob oxiridagi Photo
File bo'limida.


MAQOLA QOLIPI (99-bet matnlari
kabi):
  1 Qayerda yashaydi / uchraydi
  2 Nega xavf ostida
  3 Taklif qilingan yechim


⚠ 'A JAGUAR':

  = yaguar. /ˈdʒæɡjuə/.

structure.headingUz: Yaguar: qayerda, nega xavf ostida, yechim
structure.modelEn: The jaguar is the largest cat in South America. It lives in the rainforests of Central and South America. Jaguars are facing extinction because they are hunted for their beautiful fur and because the rainforests are being destroyed. In my opinion, hunting jaguars should be banned and the rainforests should be protected.
structure.modelUz: Yaguar - Janubiy Amerikadagi eng katta mushuk. U Markaziy va Janubiy Amerika tropik o'rmonlarida yashaydi. Yaguarlar yo'qolib ketish xavfida, chunki ular go'zal mo'ynasi uchun ovlanadi va tropik o'rmonlar vayron qilinmoqda. Mening fikrimcha, yaguar ovi taqiqlanishi va tropik o'rmonlar himoya qilinishi kerak.

structure.headingUz: Afrika fili: qayerda, nega xavf ostida, yechim
structure.modelEn: The African elephant is the largest land animal in the world. It is found in central and southern Africa. African elephants are in danger of becoming extinct because hunters kill them for their ivory tusks. I believe that people should stop buying ivory products and elephants should be protected in national parks.
structure.modelUz: Afrika fili - dunyodagi eng katta quruqlik hayvoni. U markaziy va janubiy Afrikada uchraydi. Afrika fillari yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida, chunki ovchilar ularni fil suyagi tishlari uchun o'ldiradi. Menimcha, odamlar fil suyagi mahsulotlarini sotib olishni to'xtatishi va fillar milliy bog'larda himoya qilinishi kerak.

In my opinion, hunting jaguars should be banned and the rainforests should be protected.

The African elephant is the largest land animal in the world. It is found in central and southern Africa. African elephants are in danger of becoming extinct because hunters kill them for their ivory tusks. I believe that people should stop buying ivory products and elephants should be protected in national parks.

Mening fikrimcha, yaguar ovi taqiqlanishi va tropik o'rmonlar himoya qilinishi kerak.

Afrika fili - dunyodagi eng katta quruqlik hayvoni. U markaziy va janubiy Afrikada uchraydi. Afrika fillari yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida, chunki ovchilar ularni fil suyagi tishlari uchun o'ldiradi. Menimcha, odamlar fil suyagi mahsulotlarini sotib olishni to'xtatishi va fillar milliy bog'larda himoya qilinishi kerak.
